question: For which novel did Valeria Luiselli win the International Dublin Literary Award 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lost Children Archive.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Valeria Luiselli** is a **Mexican author, who **won the International Dublin Literary Award 2021 for her work Lost Children Archive
 
• It is a novel based on the theme of the separation of children from their parents near the Mexico-America border.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **International Dublin Literary Prize**

 
 
• The prize is among the **richest literary awards** given to the works in English literature
 
• **Akhil Sharma**, an Indian-American is the **recipient of the Prize in 2016**, for his novel **Family Life**.
 
• Established in 1994, the International Dublin Literary Award is considered one of the world’s wealthiest awards for literature with prize money of €100,000 (approximately INR 89,27,300).
 
• The award is given to a novel written or translated into English.
